audit_summary.pulse_cyan_leaks: Instances found in GymAxis authenticated pages (e.g., MasterAdmin/AdminMODConsole.js, MasterAdmin/PricingPanel.js, ActivationFunnelPanel.js) using `var(--color-brand-cyan)` or `#19CDFF`. This violates the isolation rule, leaking Pulse's cyan into GymAxis.
audit_summary.dark_tokens_on_light_mode: Hardcoded dark backgrounds (`bg-[var(--color-surface-dark-alt)]`, `bg-[#121212]`, `bg-[#171717]`) applied directly on cards in light mode (e.g., MasterAdmin/AdminCRMUsers.js, SiconIntegrationTab.js, AboutPage.js). This creates the 'Black cards all throughout the site on light mode' bug.
audit_summary.modal_violations: Modals pop up in inconsistent positions (some centered, some right drawers), lack a uniform top-right close 'X', and have nested `overflow-y-auto` causing double internal vertical sliders (e.g., AdminOrganizations.js, PricingPanel.js, AdminOnboardingPackets.js).

refresh_blueprint.pulse_isolation_rule: CRITICAL: DO NOT redesign Pulse Fitness branded pages. Any component or route under `data-brand="pulse"` or `/pulse` MUST REMAIN UNTOUCHED (keep Proxima Nova / Cyan). GymAxis surfaces MUST NEVER use Pulse Cyan (`var(--color-brand-cyan)` or `#19CDFF`); use the GymAxis navy/purple gradient.
refresh_blueprint.typography: GymAxis: Headings (Satoshi), Body (Inter). Ensure text classes use `text-slate-900` for headings and `text-slate-600` or `text-muted-foreground` for body in light mode.
refresh_blueprint.palette_tweaks: Migrate black card backgrounds to `bg-card` or `var(--gx-bg-paper)` and remove hardcoded dark shades. Change all GymAxis CTA and active pills to use `gx-btn-primary`, `gx-btn-secondary`, or explicit brand gradients (`var(--gx-brand-from)` to `var(--gx-brand-to)`).
refresh_blueprint.motion_patterns: Fast native feel (`transition-all duration-200 ease-out`). Hover interactions should subtly lift elements (`hover:-translate-y-0.5`, `hover:shadow-md`).

modal_chrome_spec.default_position: Centered on screen. Do not use right-side drawers manually unless it is an explicitly global Sheet pattern. Use `Dialog` from shadcn/ui.
modal_chrome_spec.x_close_button: MUST exist on every modal. Position: absolute top-4 right-4. Icon: `<X className="w-4 h-4" />` (lucide-react). Structure: A button with `h-8 w-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500`.
modal_chrome_spec.max_height_overflow: Outer DialogContent MUST have `max-h-[90vh]` or `max-h-[calc(100vh-4rem)]` with `overflow-y-auto`. Internal form/body sections MUST NOT have `overflow-y-auto`. Scroll the whole dialog body as one single piece.
modal_chrome_spec.focus_trap: Use native shadcn/ui Dialog primitives which handle focus trapping out of the box.

card_pattern_spec.background: bg-card or bg-white (var(--gx-bg-paper)). NEVER use hardcoded dark hex codes for cards.
card_pattern_spec.header_rhythm: flex items-center justify-between mb-6. Title is text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900.
card_pattern_spec.footer_rhythm: mt-6 pt-4 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-end gap-3.
card_pattern_spec.consistency: Apply this rhythm universally to 'Create Class' in Memberships, 'Edit Org' in Master Admin, and all dashboard metric cards.

rollout_classes_and_variables.css_variables_migration: Use `--background`, `--foreground`, `--card`, `--card-foreground` for surfaces. Use `--gx-brand-from` to `--gx-brand-to` for accents instead of legacy cyan.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Search and replace `bg-[var(--color-surface-dark-alt)]`, `bg-[#121212]`, and `bg-[#171717]` with `bg-card` or `gx-card` across all GymAxis pages. 2. Purge `var(--color-brand-cyan)` from GymAxis files, replacing with `var(--gx-brand-from)` or the `gx-grad-text` utility. 3. Refactor all Modals/Dialogs to use the unified modal_chrome_spec layout (centered `DialogContent`, max-h-[90vh], overflow-y-auto, NO nested scrollbars, absolute top-4 right-4 X close button). 4. Ensure Pulse routes (`/pulse` or `data-brand="pulse"`) are 100% UNTOUCHED. 5. Add `data-testid` to all interactive components.
